title: Drums CSV
documented_semantics: Field meanings based on 2026-11-19 developer dictionary, with RC1 panning fields verified by current integration tests. Runtime validator determines actual acceptance.

columns.name: composition_title
columns.description: Shared song title; identifies which composition the drum part belongs to.

columns.name: composition_total_measures
columns.description: Full count of bars in the piece, including measures with no drum hits.

columns.name: composition_end_tick
columns.description: Absolute closing barline tick of the final full measure.
columns.blank_means: Required; do not use last hit time as song end.

columns.name: tempo_bpm
columns.description: Quarter-note tempo of the composition.
columns.blank_means: Required; must match the rest of the song.

columns.name: time_signature
columns.description: Shared musical meter.
columns.blank_means: Required; must match the rest of the song.

columns.name: ticks_per_quarter
columns.description: Tick resolution defining the drum timeline.
columns.blank_means: Required; must match the rest of the song.

columns.name: event_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for this drum event; use it to review edits.

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: Type of drum event represented.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: hit in verified sample; other values require validator confirmation
columns.blank_means: Required; do not invent a new type.

columns.name: measure
columns.description: One-based measure containing the event onset.

columns.name: absolute_tick
columns.description: Absolute attack tick since composition start.

columns.name: onset_tick_in_measure
columns.description: Attack offset in ticks relative to the start of this bar.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Nonnegative integer less than measure tick length

columns.name: timing_offset_ms
columns.description: Optional microtiming deviation in milliseconds from the grid-aligned hit.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Signed/unsigned millisecond value; exact accepted bounds need validator check

columns.name: duration_ticks
columns.description: Length in ticks assigned to the trigger/release event, not necessarily acoustic sample tail.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Positive integer ticks in hit examples

columns.name: surface_id
columns.description: Musical playing surface such as kick or snare, independent of the loaded SoundFont mapping.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Surface identifier; verified values include kick_1, snare_1, hihat_1
columns.blank_means: Required for a hit; kit mapping resolves actual MIDI note.

columns.name: articulation
columns.description: Surface-specific way of striking, e.g. closed hi-hat.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Text; closed and open appear in verified fixture
columns.blank_means: Blank means standard/unspecified articulation for the surface.

columns.name: variant_id
columns.description: Optional sample/performance variation within an articulation or kit.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Text identifier resolved by drum kit/mapping

columns.name: velocity
columns.description: Attack intensity for this individual hit.

columns.name: note_off_velocity
columns.description: Optional MIDI release strength for this hit.

columns.name: note_off_method
columns.description: MIDI representation used when releasing the event.
columns.blank_means: No explicit override; follow validated kit policy.

columns.name: choke_group
columns.description: Identifier linking sounds that cut each other off, such as exclusive cymbal/hi-hat groups.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Text group ID; playback support depends on kit mapping

columns.name: Pan_Position
columns.description: Places this musical note or drum hit in the stereo field; each event can be positioned independently.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Whole integer −100 (hard left) through 0 (centre) to +100 (hard right); fractional positions and values outside the range are rejected by RC1 pan validation.
columns.blank_means: No authored pan override; preserve the loaded SoundFont’s native stereo placement. A blank is NOT the same as 0.
